g_codes.name: Rapid Positioning
g_codes.description: Moves tool at maximum rapid rate to specified position. Not for cutting.
g_codes.warning: No material removal. Confirm clearance before rapid moves.

g_codes.name: Linear Interpolation
g_codes.description: Straight-line feed move at programmed feedrate.

g_codes.name: Circular Interpolation CW
g_codes.description: Clockwise circular arc motion.
g_codes.syntax: G02 X_ Y_ I_ J_ F_  or  G02 X_ Y_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Circular Interpolation CCW
g_codes.description: Counter-clockwise circular arc motion.
g_codes.syntax: G03 X_ Y_ I_ J_ F_  or  G03 X_ Y_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Dwell
g_codes.description: Pause program for specified time. P value is milliseconds (Haas) or seconds (Sinumerik).
g_codes.warning: P unit differs between Haas (ms) and Sinumerik (s).

g_codes.name: High Speed Machining Mode
g_codes.description: Activates high-speed machining mode for smoother motion at high feed rates.

g_codes.name: Exact Stop (Non-Modal)
g_codes.description: Single-block exact stop. Decelerates to zero before proceeding to next block.

g_codes.name: Programmable Data Input
g_codes.description: Allows work offsets and tool offsets to be set from within the program.
g_codes.syntax: G10 L2 P1 X_ Y_ Z_ (set G54)  |  G10 L1 P_ R_ Z_ (set tool offset)
g_codes.warning: G10 permanently modifies offset tables. Double-check values before running.

g_codes.name: Circular Pocket Milling CW
g_codes.description: Clockwise circular pocket milling cycle.
g_codes.warning: Haas-specific. I=radius, Z=depth, Q=peck.

g_codes.name: Circular Pocket Milling CCW
g_codes.description: Counter-clockwise circular pocket milling cycle.

g_codes.name: Polar Coordinate OFF
g_codes.description: Cancels polar coordinate mode.

g_codes.name: Polar Coordinate ON
g_codes.description: Activates polar coordinate input mode.

g_codes.name: XY Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select XY as the active interpolation plane. Default for most milling operations.

g_codes.name: XZ Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select XZ as the active interpolation plane.

g_codes.name: YZ Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select YZ as the active interpolation plane.

g_codes.name: Imperial Units (Haas)
g_codes.description: Set units to inches. All subsequent values in inches.
g_codes.warning: Affects all axis values, feedrates, and offsets.

g_codes.name: Metric Units
g_codes.description: Set units to millimeters.

g_codes.name: Return to Reference Point
g_codes.description: Return to machine home position via intermediate point.
g_codes.warning: Always use G91 G28 Z0 to safely retract Z before XY home.

g_codes.name: Return from Reference Point
g_codes.description: Move from reference point to the intermediate point used in G28.
g_codes.warning: Use after G28 to return to the work area.

g_codes.name: Return to 2nd Reference Point
g_codes.description: Return to the second reference point (often used for tool change position).

g_codes.name: Skip Function (Probing)
g_codes.description: Feed move that stops when a skip signal is received — used for probing.
g_codes.warning: Requires a probing input signal. Do not use without a probe connected.

g_codes.name: Thread Cutting (Constant Lead)
g_codes.description: Single-point thread cutting on lathe at constant lead.
g_codes.warning: F is thread lead (pitch).

g_codes.name: Thread Cutting (Constant Pitch)
g_codes.description: Thread cutting at constant pitch on lathe.
g_codes.warning: K is thread pitch in mm.

g_codes.name: Automatic Tool Length Measurement
g_codes.description: Measures tool length automatically using tool setter.
g_codes.warning: Requires tool setter probe installed.

g_codes.name: Cancel Tool Radius Compensation
g_codes.description: Turn off cutter radius compensation (G41/G42).

g_codes.name: Tool Radius Comp Left
g_codes.description: Compensate tool radius to the left of programmed path.
g_codes.warning: Must be engaged during a linear move (G01).

g_codes.name: Tool Radius Comp Right
g_codes.description: Compensate tool radius to the right of programmed path.
g_codes.warning: Must be engaged during a linear move (G01).

g_codes.name: Tool Length Compensation + (Haas)
g_codes.description: Apply positive tool length offset from offset table.
g_codes.warning: H value must match tool number in offset table.

g_codes.name: Tool Length Compensation - (Haas)
g_codes.description: Apply negative tool length offset (rarely used).
g_codes.warning: Reverses direction of tool length compensation.

g_codes.name: Tool Length Compensation Scaling
g_codes.description: Applies scaling factor to tool length compensation.

g_codes.name: Engraving
g_codes.description: Text engraving canned cycle.
g_codes.syntax: G47 P_ X_ Y_ Z_ F_ E_ J_
g_codes.warning: Haas-specific. P=ASCII character, E=depth.

g_codes.name: Cancel Tool Length Compensation
g_codes.description: Cancel active tool length offset.

g_codes.name: Maximum Spindle Speed Clamp (CSS)
g_codes.description: Sets maximum RPM limit when using G96 CSS (constant surface speed).
g_codes.warning: Always program G50 S_max before G96 to prevent runaway RPM at small diameters.

g_codes.name: Scaling
g_codes.description: Scales programmed coordinates by a factor relative to a specified center.
g_codes.syntax: G51 X_ Y_ Z_ P_ (Haas: P=scale factor × 1000)
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G50 (Haas) or SCALE OFF (Sinumerik).

g_codes.name: Local Coordinate System Shift
g_codes.description: Shifts the current work coordinate system by a specified amount.
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G52 X0 Y0 Z0 at end of operation.

g_codes.name: Machine Coordinate System
g_codes.description: Non-modal move in machine coordinate system.
g_codes.warning: Single-block only. Not modal.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 1
g_codes.description: Select work offset G54. Most common WCS for first setup.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 2
g_codes.description: Select work offset G55.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 3
g_codes.description: Select work offset G56.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 4
g_codes.description: Select work offset G57.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 5
g_codes.description: Select work offset G58.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 6
g_codes.description: Select work offset G59.

g_codes.name: Exact Stop Mode
g_codes.description: All moves decelerate to exact stop before starting next block. Reduces corner rounding.
g_codes.warning: Slows cycle time significantly. Use G64 for general machining.

g_codes.name: Tapping Mode (Haas)
g_codes.description: Enables rigid tapping. Synchronizes spindle and feed.

g_codes.name: Cutting Mode (Continuous Path)
g_codes.description: Default path blending mode. Allows cornering without exact stop for faster machining.

g_codes.name: Macro Subprogram Call (Non-Modal)
g_codes.description: Call a custom macro program with arguments.

g_codes.name: Macro Subprogram Call (Modal)
g_codes.description: Modal macro call — executes on every subsequent motion block.
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G67 when done.

g_codes.name: Cancel Modal Macro Call
g_codes.description: Cancels a modal macro call set by G66.

g_codes.name: Coordinate Rotation
g_codes.description: Rotates the coordinate system by a specified angle around the selected plane.
g_codes.syntax: G68 X_ Y_ R_ (Haas: R = rotation angle in degrees)
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G69 at end of rotated operation.

g_codes.name: Cancel Coordinate Rotation
g_codes.description: Cancels coordinate rotation set by G68.

g_codes.name: Finishing Cycle (Lathe)
g_codes.description: Lathe finishing cycle using previously defined profile.
g_codes.warning: P=start block, Q=end block of roughing profile.

g_codes.name: Stock Removal Roughing (Lathe)
g_codes.description: Lathe roughing cycle for OD/ID turning.
g_codes.syntax: G71 U_ R_  /  G71 P_ Q_ U_ W_ F_
g_codes.warning: U=depth of cut, R=retract, W=finish allowance Z.

g_codes.name: Stock Removal Facing (Lathe)
g_codes.description: Lathe facing roughing cycle.
g_codes.syntax: G72 W_ R_  /  G72 P_ Q_ U_ W_ F_
g_codes.warning: W=depth of cut per pass.

g_codes.name: High-Speed Peck Drilling
g_codes.description: Peck drilling with partial retract (chip breaking). Tool does not fully retract between pecks.
g_codes.syntax: G73 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_  (Q = peck increment)
g_codes.warning: Chips may not fully clear hole. Use G83 for deep holes in difficult materials.

g_codes.name: Left-Hand Tapping Cycle
g_codes.description: Left-hand tapping (counter-clockwise thread). Reverses spindle at bottom.
g_codes.syntax: G74 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: F must equal RPM × pitch (mm). Incorrect F breaks taps.

g_codes.name: Grooving Cycle (Lathe)
g_codes.description: Peck grooving canned cycle for lathe.
g_codes.syntax: G75 R_  /  G75 X_ Z_ P_ Q_ F_
g_codes.warning: R=retract amount.

g_codes.name: Fine Boring Cycle
g_codes.description: Boring cycle that orients spindle and shifts tool before retracting to avoid scratching bore wall.
g_codes.syntax: G76 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ P_ F_  (Q = shift distance)
g_codes.warning: Requires oriented spindle stop capability.

g_codes.name: Cancel Canned Cycle
g_codes.description: Cancels any active canned cycle (drilling, tapping, etc.).

g_codes.name: Drilling Canned Cycle
g_codes.description: Simple drilling cycle: drill to depth, rapid out.
g_codes.syntax: G81 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Spot Drilling / Drilling with Dwell
g_codes.description: Drilling with a dwell at the bottom. Used for spotting, countersinking, or controlled depth.
g_codes.syntax: G82 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ P_ F_  (P = dwell in ms)

g_codes.name: Peck Drilling Cycle
g_codes.description: Deep hole peck drilling with full retract to R plane between pecks.
g_codes.syntax: G83 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_  (Q = peck depth)

g_codes.name: Tapping Cycle
g_codes.description: Right-hand tapping cycle. Feedrate must match: F = RPM × Pitch.
g_codes.syntax: G84 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: Calculate F carefully: F = RPM × Pitch (mm). Wrong F breaks taps.

g_codes.name: Boring — Feed In, Feed Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle that feeds both in and out. Leaves a good finish on both passes.
g_codes.syntax: G85 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Boring — Stop Spindle, Rapid Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle: feeds to depth, stops spindle, retracts rapidly.
g_codes.syntax: G86 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: May leave a witness mark. Use G76 for fine bores.

g_codes.name: Back Boring Cycle
g_codes.description: Back boring canned cycle for counterbore on opposite side.
g_codes.syntax: G87 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ I_ J_ K_ F_
g_codes.warning: Requires oriented spindle stop (M19).

g_codes.name: Boring — Feed In, Dwell, Feed Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle with dwell at depth, then feed out.
g_codes.syntax: G89 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ P_ F_  (P = dwell in ms)

g_codes.name: Absolute Programming
g_codes.description: All coordinates measured from program zero (WCS origin).

g_codes.name: Incremental Programming
g_codes.description: All coordinates measured from current position.
g_codes.warning: Easy source of crashes. Verify incremental values carefully.

g_codes.name: Set Work Coordinate Origin
g_codes.description: Shifts the active WCS so that current position equals the programmed coordinates.
g_codes.warning: G92 is a local shift — cancel with G92 X0 Y0 Z0.

g_codes.name: Inverse Time Feed Rate Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate F specifies feed in inverse time (blocks per minute). Used with 5-axis moves.
g_codes.warning: F must be re-programmed every block.

g_codes.name: Feed per Minute Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate in mm/min or in/min. Default mode.

g_codes.name: Feed per Revolution Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate in mm/rev or in/rev. Commonly used in turning.

g_codes.name: Constant Surface Speed (CSS)
g_codes.description: Spindle speed varies to maintain constant cutting speed as diameter changes. Used in turning.
g_codes.syntax: G96 S_ (CSS value in m/min or SFM)
g_codes.warning: Always program G50 S_max before G96 to limit maximum RPM.

g_codes.name: Constant RPM Mode
g_codes.description: Spindle speed is constant RPM regardless of diameter.

g_codes.name: Return to Initial Plane (Canned Cycles)
g_codes.description: After canned cycle, retract Z to initial Z height (before cycle started).
g_codes.syntax: G98 G81 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Return to R Plane (Canned Cycles)
g_codes.description: After canned cycle, retract Z only to R plane. Faster for repeated holes.
g_codes.syntax: G99 G83 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_
g_codes.warning: Ensure clearance between holes when using G99 with fixtures.

g_codes.name: Disable Mirror Image
g_codes.description: Disables axis mirror image.

g_codes.name: Enable Mirror Image
g_codes.description: Enables axis mirror image.

g_codes.name: Block Look-Ahead Limit
g_codes.description: Limits block look-ahead buffer.
g_codes.warning: P=number of blocks. P0 cancels.

g_codes.name: Work Offset #7 (Haas)
g_codes.description: Additional work coordinate offset G54.1 P1.

g_codes.name: Work Offset #8 (Haas)
g_codes.description: Additional work coordinate offset G54.1 P2.

g_codes.name: Work Offset #9 (Haas)
g_codes.description: Additional work coordinate offset G54.1 P3.

g_codes.name: Work Offset #10 (Haas)
g_codes.description: Additional work coordinate offset G54.1 P4.

g_codes.name: Work Offset #11 (Haas)
g_codes.description: Additional work coordinate offset G54.1 P5.

g_codes.name: Select Work Offset P1-P99
g_codes.description: Selects extended work coordinate offsets P1 through P99.
g_codes.warning: P=offset number (1-99).

g_codes.name: Surface Smoothing Control
g_codes.description: Controls accuracy vs. speed in contouring.
g_codes.warning: P=mode (1=rough,2=medium,3=finish), E=tolerance.

m_codes.name: Program Stop
m_codes.description: Unconditional program stop. Requires operator to press Cycle Start to continue.

m_codes.name: Optional Stop
m_codes.description: Program stop only if Optional Stop switch is ON at control.

m_codes.name: End of Program
m_codes.description: End program execution. Rewinds to beginning.

m_codes.name: Spindle CW
m_codes.description: Start spindle clockwise (standard for milling right-hand tools).

m_codes.name: Spindle CCW
m_codes.description: Start spindle counter-clockwise (left-hand tools or special operations).

m_codes.name: Spindle Stop
m_codes.description: Stop spindle rotation.

m_codes.name: Tool Change (Haas)
m_codes.description: Execute tool change to tool in spindle. Tool number specified by T word.
m_codes.warning: Always ensure Z is at safe height before M06.

m_codes.name: Mist Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on mist (air/oil) coolant.

m_codes.name: Flood Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on flood coolant.

m_codes.name: Coolant Off
m_codes.description: Turn off all coolant.

m_codes.name: 4th Axis Clamp
m_codes.description: Clamp the rotary (4th) axis.

m_codes.name: 4th Axis Unclamp
m_codes.description: Unclamp the rotary (4th) axis.
m_codes.warning: Ensure tool is clear of part before unclamping.

m_codes.name: Spindle CW + Coolant ON
m_codes.description: Starts spindle clockwise with coolant simultaneously.

m_codes.name: Spindle CCW + Coolant ON
m_codes.description: Starts spindle counter-clockwise with coolant simultaneously.

m_codes.name: C Axis Positive Motion
m_codes.description: Positive direction C axis on lathe.

m_codes.name: C Axis Negative Motion
m_codes.description: Negative direction C axis on lathe.

m_codes.name: Spindle Orientation
m_codes.description: Orient spindle to a fixed angular position. Required before tool changes and boring with shift.

m_codes.name: Mirror X Axis
m_codes.description: Activates X axis mirroring for part programs.
m_codes.warning: Cancel with M23 at end of mirrored section.

m_codes.name: Mirror Y Axis
m_codes.description: Activates Y axis mirroring for part programs.
m_codes.warning: Cancel with M24 at end of mirrored section.

m_codes.name: Mirror X Off
m_codes.description: Cancels X axis mirroring.

m_codes.name: Mirror Y Off
m_codes.description: Cancels Y axis mirroring.

m_codes.name: Pallet Unclamp
m_codes.description: Unclamps pallet on pallet changer machines.

m_codes.name: Pallet Clamp
m_codes.description: Clamps pallet on pallet changer machines.

m_codes.name: Rigid Tapping Mode
m_codes.description: Enables rigid tapping (synchronized spindle and Z axis).

m_codes.name: End of Program (Reset)
m_codes.description: End program and reset to beginning. Standard end-of-program code.

m_codes.name: Chip Conveyor Forward
m_codes.description: Starts chip conveyor in forward direction.

m_codes.name: Chip Conveyor Stop
m_codes.description: Stops chip conveyor.

m_codes.name: Chip Conveyor Reverse
m_codes.description: Starts chip conveyor in reverse direction.

m_codes.name: Coolant Spigot Increment
m_codes.description: Increments programmable coolant nozzle position.

m_codes.name: Pallet Part Ready
m_codes.description: Signals pallet part is ready for exchange.

m_codes.name: Spindle Low Gear
m_codes.description: Select low gear range on geared-head machines.

m_codes.name: Spindle High Gear
m_codes.description: Select high gear range on geared-head machines.

m_codes.name: Feed/Speed Override Enable
m_codes.description: Enables feedrate and spindle speed override knobs.

m_codes.name: Feed/Speed Override Disable
m_codes.description: Disables feedrate and spindle speed override knobs.
m_codes.warning: Use with caution — operator cannot slow down machine.

m_codes.name: Coolant Through Spindle ON
m_codes.description: Activates through-spindle coolant (TSC).

m_codes.name: Coolant Through Spindle OFF
m_codes.description: Deactivates through-spindle coolant.

m_codes.name: No Operation (User-Defined)
m_codes.description: Available for user-defined M-code via relay/PLC.

m_codes.name: No Operation (User-Defined)
m_codes.description: Available for user-defined M-code via relay/PLC.

m_codes.name: Output Relay Set
m_codes.description: Sets output relay for M-code output.

m_codes.name: Automatic Pallet Change
m_codes.description: Executes automatic pallet change sequence.

m_codes.name: Output Relay Clear
m_codes.description: Clears output relay previously set by M59.

m_codes.name: High Pressure Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on through-spindle or high-pressure coolant (if equipped).
m_codes.warning: Verify HPC is appropriate for current operation.

m_codes.name: High Pressure Coolant Off
m_codes.description: Turn off high pressure coolant.

m_codes.name: Jump If Probe Contact
m_codes.description: Conditional branch if skip signal (probe) is active.

m_codes.name: Local Sub-Program Call
m_codes.description: Calls a local sub-program within the same program.

m_codes.name: Subprogram Call (Haas)
m_codes.description: Call a subprogram. P is program number, L is repeat count.

m_codes.name: Subprogram Return (Haas)
m_codes.description: Return from subprogram to calling program.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Drilling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Simple drilling without chip breaking. Drill to depth and retract.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Drilling with Dwell
sinumerik_cycles.description: Drilling with dwell at bottom of hole.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE82(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Deep Hole Drilling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Deep hole drilling with peck and chip breaking.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE83(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, FDEP, FDPR, DAM, DTB, DTS, FRF, VARI)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Rigid Tapping
sinumerik_cycles.description: Tapping with spindle synchronization.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE84(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDAC, MPIT, PIT, POSS, SST, SST1)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Boring 1 (Reaming)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Boring/reaming cycle with feed in and programmable feed out.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE85(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, FFR, RFF)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Tapping with Compensating Chuck
sinumerik_cycles.description: Tapping cycle with compensating chuck.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Boring 2 (With Shift)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Boring with oriented spindle stop and shift before retract — prevents scratch on bore wall.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE86(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDIR, RPA, RPO, RPAP, POSS)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Rectangular Pocket Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Milling of rectangular pockets with roughing and finishing passes.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: POCKET3(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, LENG, WID, CRAD, PA, PO, STA, MID, FAL, FALD, FFP1, FFD, CDIR, VARI, ...)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Circular Pocket Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Milling of circular (round) pockets.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: POCKET4(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, PRAD, PA, PO, MID, FAL, FALD, FFP1, FFD, CDIR, VARI, ...)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Spigot Cycle
sinumerik_cycles.description: Spigot (boss) milling cycle for circular raised features.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Rectangular Stud Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Rectangular stud (island) milling cycle.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Circular Stud Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Circular stud milling cycle.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Thread Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Helical thread milling cycle using a thread milling cutter.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE90(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DIATH, KDIAM, PIT, FFR, CDIR, TYPTH, CPA, CPO)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Swivel Plane
sinumerik_cycles.description: Swivels working plane for 5-axis machining.

sinumerik_cycles.name: High Speed Cutting Settings
sinumerik_cycles.description: Configures high speed cutting parameters.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Thread Cutting (Lathe)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Thread cutting cycle for lathe operation.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Stock Removal Turning
sinumerik_cycles.description: Stock removal cycle for turning operations.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Undercut Cycle
sinumerik_cycles.description: DIN undercut cycle for turning.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Modal Cycle Call
sinumerik_cycles.description: Activates a cycle modally so it executes at every subsequent position block.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax:
MCALL CYCLE81(...)  ; then list positions
MCALL  ; to deactivate
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Always deactivate with MCALL (no arguments) when done.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Spindle Position
sinumerik_cycles.description: Position the spindle to an exact angle. Used before oriented operations.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Programmable Zero Offset (Absolute)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Shifts the current workpiece coordinate system by an absolute value.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Cancel with TRANS (no arguments) at end of shifted section.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Programmable Zero Offset (Additive)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Shifts the WCS additively on top of an existing TRANS or frame.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Coordinate Rotation
sinumerik_cycles.description: Rotates the active coordinate frame around the selected plane axis.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Scaling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Scales the coordinate system by a specified factor per axis.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Cancel with SCALE X1 Y1 Z1.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Face Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Facing cycle. Mills a flat surface over a defined area with specified step-over and depth.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Contour Pocket Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Mills a pocket defined by an external contour subroutine. Supports roughing and finishing strategies.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Axis Mirroring (Sinumerik)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Mirror the workpiece coordinate system about specified axes. Cancel with MIRROR (no args).
sinumerik_cycles.syntax:
MIRROR X0  (mirror X axis)
MIRROR X0 Y0  (mirror both)
MIRROR  (cancel)
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Cancel after mirrored section to restore normal orientation.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Additive Rotation
sinumerik_cycles.description: Adds a rotation on top of an existing frame transformation without cancelling it.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Chained Translation
sinumerik_cycles.description: Adds a translation offset on top of existing TRANS, preserving the previous frame shift.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Inch Programming (Sinumerik)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Switch Sinumerik control to inch units. Use G71 to return to metric.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Switches all subsequent dimensional values to inches.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Polar Coordinate (Intermediate Point)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Polar coordinate move with pole at last programmed intermediate position.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Polar Coordinate (From WCS Zero)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Polar coordinate move with pole at workpiece zero point.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Polar Coordinate (From Last Point)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Polar coordinate move with pole at the last programmed point.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Repeat Program Section
sinumerik_cycles.description: Repeat a labeled program section a specified number of times.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax:
LABEL1:
... (program section) ...
GOTO LABEL1  P_  (P = repeat count)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Stop Pre-processing
sinumerik_cycles.description: Forces the control to execute all pending blocks before continuing. Used before measurements or tool changes.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Reduces look-ahead. Use only when synchronization is needed.

fanuc_codes.name: Programmable Offset Input
fanuc_codes.description: Set work offsets (L2) or tool offsets (L11/L10) from within the program.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G10 L2 P1 X_ Y_ Z_  (set G54)
G10 L11 P_ R_  (tool wear)
fanuc_codes.warning: Permanently changes offset tables. Verify before running.

fanuc_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Interpolation
fanuc_codes.description: Converts linear X/Y moves into rotary (C) + linear motion.
fanuc_codes.warning: For mill-turn and rotary axis applications.

fanuc_codes.name: Tool Retract and Recover
fanuc_codes.description: Temporarily retract tool from machining position for inspection or chip clearing, then recover.
fanuc_codes.warning: Program recovery move precisely to avoid re-entry crash.

fanuc_codes.name: Circular Pocket Milling CW
fanuc_codes.description: Machines a circular pocket in a clockwise direction.

fanuc_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Interpolation ON
fanuc_codes.description: Enables polar coordinate interpolation mode.

fanuc_codes.name: Circular Pocket Milling CCW
fanuc_codes.description: Machines a circular pocket in a counter-clockwise direction.

fanuc_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Interpolation OFF
fanuc_codes.description: Cancels polar coordinate interpolation.

fanuc_codes.name: Cancel Polar Coordinates
fanuc_codes.description: Cancels polar coordinate programming mode set by G16.

fanuc_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Mode
fanuc_codes.description: Enables polar coordinate programming. X = radius, Y = angle.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G16
G01 X_ Y_  (X=radius, Y=angle deg)
fanuc_codes.warning: Cancel with G15 when done.

fanuc_codes.name: Spindle Speed Fluctuation Detection Off
fanuc_codes.description: Disables spindle speed fluctuation detection. Used during threading to prevent false alarms.

fanuc_codes.name: Spindle Speed Fluctuation Detection On
fanuc_codes.description: Enables spindle speed fluctuation detection.

fanuc_codes.name: Reference Return Check
fanuc_codes.description: Checks that the axis is at the reference point position after a G28 return.
fanuc_codes.warning: Generates alarm if axes are not at reference position.

fanuc_codes.name: 2nd / 3rd / 4th Reference Return
fanuc_codes.description: Returns axis to alternate reference positions (P2, P3, or P4). P2 is often the tool change position.

fanuc_codes.name: Auto Tool Offset X (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Automatic tool length measurement in X axis on turning centers.
fanuc_codes.warning: Requires tool measurement probe.

fanuc_codes.name: Auto Tool Offset Z (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Automatic tool length measurement in Z axis on turning centers.
fanuc_codes.warning: Requires tool measurement probe.

fanuc_codes.name: Tool Centre Point Control
fanuc_codes.description: Tool Centre Point (TCP) control mode. Maintains tool tip position during tilted-plane moves.
fanuc_codes.warning: Requires 5-axis option. Cancel with G49.

fanuc_codes.name: Mirror Image Cancel
fanuc_codes.description: Cancels programmed mirror image.

fanuc_codes.name: Mirror Image
fanuc_codes.description: Activates programmed mirror image on specified axes.

fanuc_codes.name: Machine Coordinate System
fanuc_codes.description: Temporarily select machine coordinate system (absolute from machine home). Non-modal.
fanuc_codes.warning: Machine coordinates, not part coordinates. Confirm safe position.

fanuc_codes.name: Additional Work Offsets
fanuc_codes.description: Selects additional work coordinate offsets P1-P48.
fanuc_codes.warning: P=offset number.

fanuc_codes.name: High Speed Machining Mode
fanuc_codes.description: FANUC High Speed Machining mode. Optimises look-ahead and acceleration for complex contours.
fanuc_codes.warning: Check machine parameter settings for max look-ahead blocks.

fanuc_codes.name: AI Contour Control
fanuc_codes.description: FANUC AI Contour Control — smooths programmed paths at high feedrates to reduce cycle time.
fanuc_codes.warning: Only available with FANUC AI-CC option.

fanuc_codes.name: Unidirectional Positioning
fanuc_codes.description: All positioning approaches the final point from the same direction to eliminate backlash error.
fanuc_codes.warning: Slower than normal positioning. Use only where backlash is critical.

fanuc_codes.name: 5-Axis Coordinate Rotation
fanuc_codes.description: Enables 5-axis tilted working plane.
fanuc_codes.syntax: G68.1 X_ Y_ Z_ I_ J_ K_
fanuc_codes.warning: Requires 5-axis option.

fanuc_codes.name: Tilted Work Plane (5-Axis)
fanuc_codes.description: 5-axis tilted work plane command. Sets a machining plane in 3D space using Euler or tilt/azimuth angles.
fanuc_codes.syntax: G68.2 X_ Y_ Z_ I_ J_ K_
fanuc_codes.warning: Requires 5-axis machine with FANUC 5-axis option.

fanuc_codes.name: Cancel 5-Axis Rotation
fanuc_codes.description: Cancels 5-axis tilted working plane.

fanuc_codes.name: Finishing Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Lathe finishing pass cycle. Used after G71 or G72 roughing to cut to final dimensions.
fanuc_codes.syntax: G70 P_ Q_  (P=first block, Q=last block of profile)
fanuc_codes.warning: Must follow G71 or G72 roughing.

fanuc_codes.name: Stock Removal in Turning (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Multiple-pass roughing cycle for external or internal turning. Follows a programmed profile.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G71 U_ R_  (U=depth/pass, R=retract)
G71 P_ Q_ U_ W_ F_
fanuc_codes.warning: U and W are finish allowances. Remove with G70.

fanuc_codes.name: Stock Removal in Facing (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Multiple-pass facing roughing cycle.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G72 W_ R_
G72 P_ Q_ U_ W_ F_
fanuc_codes.warning: Similar to G71 but for facing direction.

fanuc_codes.name: Pattern Repeat Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Repeats a programmed profile shape, shifting each time. Used for cast or forged blanks.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G73 U_ W_ R_
G73 P_ Q_ U_ W_ F_
fanuc_codes.warning: Profile must already be near net shape (forging/casting).

fanuc_codes.name: End Face Grooving Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Peck drilling/grooving in the Z direction on end face of turning center.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G74 R_
G74 X_ Z_ P_ Q_ R_ F_

fanuc_codes.name: OD/ID Grooving Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Peck grooving in the X (radial) direction.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G75 R_
G75 X_ Z_ P_ Q_ R_ F_

fanuc_codes.name: Thread Cutting Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Multi-pass threading cycle for external or internal threads.
fanuc_codes.syntax:
G76 P_ Q_ R_
G76 X_ Z_ R_ P_ Q_ F_
fanuc_codes.warning: Calculate X (minor dia) and F (pitch) carefully.

fanuc_codes.name: Thread Cutting — Single Pass (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Single-pass thread cutting move on lathe. Repeat with decreasing X for multi-pass threading.
fanuc_codes.syntax: G92 X_ Z_ F_  (F = thread pitch in mm)
fanuc_codes.warning: Each G92 repetition removes material. Control depth with X value.

fanuc_codes.name: End Face Cutting Cycle (Lathe)
fanuc_codes.description: Single-pass facing cycle on lathe.

fanuc_codes.name: General Pocket Milling (30i/31i)
fanuc_codes.description: Arbitrary-shape pocket milling cycle available on FANUC 30i/31i/32i Series controls.
fanuc_codes.warning: Only available on FANUC 30i/31i/32i Series.

fanuc_codes.name: Lubricant On
fanuc_codes.description: Activate way lube or lubricant system (machine-dependent).
fanuc_codes.warning: Availability depends on machine builder option.

fanuc_codes.name: Lubricant Off
fanuc_codes.description: Deactivate way lube or lubricant system.

heidenhain_codes.name: Linear Traverse
heidenhain_codes.description: Move tool in a straight line to the programmed position. Equivalent to G01 in ISO.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: L X+_ Y+_ Z+_ F_  RR/RL/R0  (RR=radius right, RL=radius left, R0=no compensation)

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Traverse (Center)
heidenhain_codes.description: Arc move using a previously defined circle center (CC). Direction set by DR+ (CCW) or DR- (CW).
heidenhain_codes.syntax: C X+_ Y+_ DR+  F_  (CCW arc to X,Y)
heidenhain_codes.warning: Must define CC before using C.

heidenhain_codes.name: Circle Center / Pole
heidenhain_codes.description: Define circle center for arc moves (C) or pole point for polar coordinate moves.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CC X+_ Y+_  or  CC  (use current position as center)

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Traverse (Radius)
heidenhain_codes.description: Arc move defined by radius R. No prior CC needed. DR+ = CCW, DR- = CW.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CR X+_ Y+_ R+_ DR+  F_
heidenhain_codes.warning: Two arcs possible with a given radius — R sign selects the minor (R+) or major (R-) arc.

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Traverse (Tangential)
heidenhain_codes.description: Arc that starts tangentially from the previous path. Ensures smooth contour transitions.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CT X+_ Y+_  F_

heidenhain_codes.name: Label (Subprogram Start/End)
heidenhain_codes.description: Marks start of a subprogram or repeat section. LBL 0 marks the end.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
LBL _  (start)
LBL 0  (end)
heidenhain_codes.warning: LBL 0 terminates the subprogram and returns control.

heidenhain_codes.name: Call Label / Subprogram
heidenhain_codes.description: Call a labeled subprogram. REP sets the number of repetitions.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CALL LBL _  REP _

heidenhain_codes.name: Tool Call
heidenhain_codes.description: Calls tool from magazine with spindle speed.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: TOOL CALL 5 Z S5000

heidenhain_codes.name: Tool Definition
heidenhain_codes.description: Defines tool parameters in program.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: TOOL DEF 5 L+100 R+10

heidenhain_codes.name: Pecking (Cycle 1)
heidenhain_codes.description: Deep hole drilling with full retract between pecks for chip evacuation.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
CYCL DEF 1.0 PECKING
  1.1 DIST _  (safety clearance)
  1.2 DEPTH _
  1.3 PECKG _  (peck increment)
  1.4 DWELL _
  1.5 F_

heidenhain_codes.name: Tapping (Cycle 2)
heidenhain_codes.description: Tapping with floating chuck. Spindle reverses at bottom of hole.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
CYCL DEF 2.0 TAPPING
  2.1 DIST _
  2.2 DEPTH _
  2.3 DWELL _
  2.4 F_
heidenhain_codes.warning: F must equal spindle speed x pitch exactly.

heidenhain_codes.name: Datum Shift (Cycle 7)
heidenhain_codes.description: Shift the active datum (workpiece zero) to a new position. Used to machine multiple identical features.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
CYCL DEF 7.0 DATUM SHIFT
  7.1 X+_
  7.2 Y+_
  7.3 Z+_
heidenhain_codes.warning: Cancel with Cycle 7 at X+0 Y+0 Z+0.

heidenhain_codes.name: Mirror Image (Cycle 8)
heidenhain_codes.description: Mirror the programmed geometry across a specified axis or axes.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
CYCL DEF 8.0 MIRROR IMAGE
  8.1 X (to mirror about X)
heidenhain_codes.warning: Cancel by calling Cycle 8 without axis specification.

heidenhain_codes.name: Rotation (Cycle 10)
heidenhain_codes.description: Rotate the active coordinate system by a specified angle. Useful for angled features.
heidenhain_codes.syntax:
CYCL DEF 10.0 ROTATION
  10.1 ROT +_  (angle in degrees)

heidenhain_codes.name: Drilling (Cycle 200)
heidenhain_codes.description: Standard drilling cycle.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 200 DRILLING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q202=_ Q210=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Reaming (Cycle 201)
heidenhain_codes.description: Reaming cycle with dwell at bottom.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 201 REAMING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q211=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Boring (Cycle 202)
heidenhain_codes.description: Boring cycle with oriented spindle stop at bottom.

heidenhain_codes.name: Universal Drilling (Cycle 203)
heidenhain_codes.description: Universal drilling cycle with peck and chip break.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 203 UNIVERSAL Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q202=_ Q210=_ Q203=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Universal Pecking (Cycle 205)
heidenhain_codes.description: Advanced peck drilling with degression.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 205 UNIVERSAL PECKING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q202=_ Q203=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Rigid Tapping (Cycle 207)
heidenhain_codes.description: Rigid tapping cycle without compensating chuck.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 207 RIGID TAPPING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q211=_ Q239=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Bore Milling (Cycle 208)
heidenhain_codes.description: Helical bore milling cycle.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 208 BORE MILLING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q334=_ Q203=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Thread Milling (Cycle 210)
heidenhain_codes.description: Thread milling cycle.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL DEF 210 THREAD MILLING Q200=_ Q201=_ Q206=_ Q239=_ Q203=_

heidenhain_codes.name: Rectangular Pocket (Cycle 251)
heidenhain_codes.description: Rectangular pocket milling cycle with multiple passes.

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Pocket (Cycle 252)
heidenhain_codes.description: Circular pocket milling cycle.

heidenhain_codes.name: Slot Milling (Cycle 253)
heidenhain_codes.description: Slot (groove) milling cycle.

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Slot (Cycle 254)
heidenhain_codes.description: Circular slot milling on a bolt circle.

heidenhain_codes.name: Rectangular Stud (Cycle 256)
heidenhain_codes.description: Rectangular stud (island) milling cycle.

heidenhain_codes.name: Circular Stud (Cycle 257)
heidenhain_codes.description: Circular stud milling cycle.

heidenhain_codes.name: Cycle Call
heidenhain_codes.description: Execute the last defined cycle at the current tool position. Positioning move must precede.
heidenhain_codes.syntax: CYCL CALL  or  CYCL CALL PAT  (on a point pattern)
heidenhain_codes.warning: Cycle must be defined before CYCL CALL.

heidenhain_codes.name: Variable Assignment (FN 0)
heidenhain_codes.description: Assign a numeric value to a Q parameter (variable). Q parameters enable parametric programming.

mazak_codes.name: Hypothetical Axis Interpolation
mazak_codes.description: Designates an axis as a 'hypothetical' (dummy) axis for interpolation purposes — used on Multi-Tasking machines so a rotary or auxiliary axis can be treated as a linear axis in a interpolation block.
mazak_codes.syntax: G07 a1 (a = axis address, 1 = enable hypothetical mode)
mazak_codes.warning: Mitsubishi/Mazak-specific. Cancel with G07 a0 before normal moves on that axis.

mazak_codes.name: Cylindrical Interpolation
mazak_codes.description: Unwraps a rotary (C) axis so that programmed linear distances on the cylinder surface are converted into the correct rotary motion — used for milling slots or grooves on a cylindrical part.
mazak_codes.warning: Program rotary axis values in linear distance units while active. Always cancel with C0 before other rotary moves.

mazak_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Interpolation ON
mazak_codes.description: Converts commanded X/C (or X/Y) motion into synchronized linear and rotary axis motion, allowing flat features (slots, flats) to be milled on a turning center using straight-line G01/G02/G03 blocks.
mazak_codes.warning: Requires C-axis and live tooling. Always pair with G13.1 to cancel.

mazak_codes.name: Polar Coordinate Interpolation OFF
mazak_codes.description: Cancels polar coordinate interpolation mode started by G12.1, returning the rotary axis to normal independent control.

mazak_codes.name: Skip Function
mazak_codes.description: Linear feed move that is aborted immediately if the skip signal (e.g. a probe or limit switch) is received, with the position at the moment of the signal captured into a system variable.
mazak_codes.warning: Following moves should reference the captured skip position before assuming probe contact occurred.

mazak_codes.name: Multi-Step Skip Functions
mazak_codes.description: Extended skip cycles (G31.1, G31.2, G31.3) used with multiple touch probes or for multi-point measurement sequences, each storing the trigger position in a separate system variable set.
mazak_codes.syntax: G31.1 X_ Y_ Z_ F_  (repeat with G31.2 / G31.3 for additional probes)
mazak_codes.warning: Probe input must be configured and enabled in the machine parameters before use.

mazak_codes.name: Coordinate System Rotation
mazak_codes.description: Rotates the programmed coordinate system about a specified center point by a given angle, allowing a feature programmed once to be repeated at multiple angular positions.
mazak_codes.syntax: G68 X_ Y_ R_ (center X/Y, rotation angle R)  ... G69 (cancel)
mazak_codes.warning: All subsequent coordinates are interpreted in the rotated system until G69 cancels it.

mazak_codes.name: Tilted Working Plane Command
mazak_codes.description: Establishes a tilted work coordinate system on a 5-axis or Multi-Tasking machine, defined by Euler angles, so that subsequent G01/G02/G03 moves and cycles are programmed in the tilted plane.
mazak_codes.syntax: G68.2 X_ Y_ Z_ I_ J_ K_  (origin + tilt angles)  followed by G53.1 to align rotary axes
mazak_codes.warning: Requires the 5-axis option. Always cancel with G69 before returning to the machine coordinate system.

mazak_codes.name: Cancel Coordinate Rotation / Tilted Plane
mazak_codes.description: Cancels an active G68 coordinate rotation or G68.2 tilted working plane, returning to the standard work coordinate system.

mazak_codes.name: Constant Surface Speed Control ON/OFF
mazak_codes.description: G96 maintains a constant cutting surface speed (m/min or sfm) by automatically adjusting spindle RPM as the turning diameter changes; G97 returns to direct RPM control.
mazak_codes.warning: Set a maximum spindle speed with G50/G92 before using G96 to prevent over-speed at small diameters.

mazak_codes.name: Maximum Spindle Speed Setting
mazak_codes.description: Sets an upper RPM limit that the control will not exceed while G96 constant surface speed control is active, protecting the chuck and workpiece at small diameters.
mazak_codes.warning: Required before G96 on parts with a wide diameter range.

mazak_codes.name: Second Reference Point Return (Turret/B-axis Index)
mazak_codes.description: Sends the specified axis (commonly the turret or B-axis on Multi-Tasking machines) to a second, user-defined reference position used for tool-change clearance.
mazak_codes.warning: Ensure the path to the second reference point is clear of fixtures and the opposing spindle/turret.

mazak_codes.name: Tailstock Advance / Retract
mazak_codes.description: M21 advances the tailstock quill to support the workpiece between centers; M22 retracts it. Used on turning centers and Multi-Tasking machines.
mazak_codes.warning: Verify tailstock pressure is appropriate for the part — excessive force can bow slender shafts.

mazak_codes.name: Hydraulic Chuck Clamp / Unclamp
mazak_codes.description: M68 clamps the hydraulic chuck (or secondary chuck on a sub-spindle) to grip the workpiece; M69 releases it.
mazak_codes.warning: Never command M69 with the spindle rotating or while a part is unsupported — workpiece can eject.

mazak_codes.name: Subprogram Call from External Device
mazak_codes.description: Calls a subprogram stored on an external device (memory card, USB, or network share) rather than from internal program memory, useful for very large programs run in DNC-style operation.
mazak_codes.warning: The external device/path must be configured and connected before the calling program runs.

mazak_codes.name: 3D Tool Radius Compensation
mazak_codes.description: Applies cutter radius compensation in three dimensions, maintaining the programmed surface offset for ball-nose and other tools moving along simultaneous 5-axis paths.
mazak_codes.warning: Requires the 5-axis/simultaneous machining option and a correctly defined tool radius (D) value.
